With only an axe he received when leaving his hometown, he makes his way to Niergen, a shield city at the front line of adventurers' battles against monsters. While barely escaping death in battles with monsters, he is supported by his first companions and, through sheer effort and determination, charges forward to becoming the (physically) strongest adventurer!! Jin seems unusually playful and clingy, poking and prodding at feelings buried in Dawoon’s heart. When Dawoon confronts him about it, a casual reply—”We just kissed”—only adds fuel to the fire.
